Shark Tooth Fossil Lot - 3 Pieces
What A Earth, Natural History & Paleontology Specimens
Fossilized Shark Teeth, Eocene to Cretaceous Era
This collection features three authentic fossilized shark tooth specimens, individually mounted in clear hinged display cases over blue foam inserts. Each specimen exhibits distinct anatomical features including intact roots, cusps, and enamel characteristic of prehistoric lamniform shark species. Packaged by What A Earth with educational background information on the reverse, these specimens offer great appeal for fossil enthusiasts, geology classrooms, and specimen collectors.
Items Included:
Fossil Shark Tooth 1 - Central triangular tooth with wide root and defined enamel crown, housed in clear plastic case
Fossil Shark Tooth 2 - Symmetrical crown with intact root lobes and light brown mineralization, housed in clear plastic case
Fossil Shark Tooth 3 - Pointed crown with lateral cusplets and root structure, housed in clear plastic case
Condition:
Teeth are in good fossilized condition with natural mineral preservation, sharp tip edges, and stable root matrix. Clear plastic display cases show light surface scuffs from handling and retail price stickers on the back cards with no cracks to the acrylic housings.

We will not accept any returns on any items that have been altered or changed from its original state as we have it listed. If you receive an item and it is not functioning properly please do not alter the item in anyway.

By bidding on items bidders understand & accept that: items are represented to the best of our ability, we are not experts in any field and items may be used or aged, and may contain minor unseen faults the buyer will take full responsibility for.
Please contact us prior to bidding to clarify any questions or concerns through the customer service tab in your shopgoodwill account. Questions will be answered within 2 business days. WE ARE CLOSED ON WEEKENDS AND ALL MAJOR HOLIDAYS.
Item description terms are as follows:
NEW - The item is New with original packaging and labels or/and factory sealed.
LIKE NEW - The item appears like new and un-used but no longer has a tag and/or original packaging.
GOOD - The item is in a good gently used condition with no major damages or defects
FAIR - The item is in a well-used condition, it may have light scratches or wear and need cleaning. Any major damages will be noted separately.
Payments
We accept US bank issued Visa, Mastercard or PayPal. We do NOT accept any form of international payment , check or money order.

If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

description:
This lot contains approximately 30+ raw mineral and rock specimens suitable for collectors and educational purposes. The collection includes various types of quartz crystals, calcite clusters, and other mineral formations. The specimens feature a range of colors including clear, white, gray, brown, green, and yellow. Most pieces are unpolished and display natural surfaces with crystal terminations, druse, and matrix formations visible on many specimens. The stones vary in size and shape. The collection is in good used condition with minor natural imperfections typical of raw mineral specimens. Pieces are suitable for display, study, or lapidary use.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.

description: This listing is for a natural stibnite (stibnite, also known as antimony) raw mineral specimen. The specimen features metallic gray, elongated bladed crystals radiating in a fan-like cluster with a bright silver sheen and some darker tarnished areas. Small whitish and grayish matrix or secondary mineral deposits are visible among the crystals. It measures approximately 2.5 x 2 x 1.75 inches and weighs about 95.4 grams as shown on a digital scale. Please note that stibnite is a naturally brittle and delicate material, so some flaking or shedding of crystals is possible. Suitable for geological and mineral collectors.
